what_is.heading: What Is GTA$ and What Can You Buy With It?
paragraphs: GTA$ is the in-game money in GTA Online. You spend it on cars, properties, businesses, weapons, upgrades and clothing, and the big business buys can cost several million.
You earn GTA$ from jobs, heists and businesses, or buy it from Rockstar as Shark Cards. Your character's money stays on that character and platform.

official_prices.heading: GTA$ Prices: Shark Cards vs DropMarket
official_prices.note: Rockstar sells GTA$ as Shark Cards. These are PlayStation Store US prices for PS5; other platforms can differ slightly.

extras.label: GTA+
extras.detail: $7.99/mo on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC Enhanced: GTA$500,000 every month plus member perks

delivery.heading: How GTA$ Delivery Works
steps: Pick an offer for your platform: PC, PlayStation or Xbox.
Read the seller's delivery note before you pay. It says exactly what they need from you.
After checkout, send those details in the order chat.
Check your character's bank balance in GTA Online, then confirm the order.

support_topic.heading: Can You Give Money to Other Players in GTA Online?
paragraphs: Not directly. GTA Online has no bank transfer between players, and the old cash-drop option was removed years ago.
The only built-in way is sharing the payout from the job you just finished with players in your session. That's why GTA$ can't be delivered like a trade in other games.

faq_extra.q: How much GTA$ is in a Megalodon Shark Card?
faq_extra.a: GTA$10,000,000 for $99.99 on the US PlayStation Store for PS5.

faq_extra.q: Does GTA+ give you money every month?
faq_extra.a: Yes. GTA+ members get GTA$500,000 each month while the membership is active, along with other perks.

notes: Shark Card amounts and prices read from five PlayStation Store US product pages (PS5) on 2026-10-05. Older/PC sources list the Megalodon as GTA$8,000,000; PS5 shows 10,000,000, so the 'where' is pinned to PS5. GTA+ price and stipend from third-party guides (gameshub/GTA Intel), not a Rockstar page: medium confidence. The no-direct-transfer fact is from third-party guides; Rockstar's own support site was not fetched. DELIVERY IS UNCLEAR: no live GTA listings, the config has no delivery method and a generic placeholder. Because GTA$ can't be traded between players, third-party GTA$ is usually delivered by account access or modded 'drops', which break Rockstar's terms and risk bans or money removal. Owner decision needed on how (or whether) this page should describe delivery; confidence is low until a real seller method exists. The current config FAQ ('game's own trade/gift system... only your username') is not true for GTA$.
